name: AX-station-01 HB-L 'Harbor' Core Hab -- modern interior (full)

gravity.note: orbital core hab: microgravity, no gravity block in the ax_b5 hand-off; crew stations are standing / free-floating (1.8 m figure upright, node_seat = hip, feet at -0.90 m along node up). No deck: the deck is not a clearance surface.
